mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(payment_id) IS NULL THEN 'PAY0001' ELSE 'PAY' || LPAD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MAX(payment_id), 4)) + 1, 4, '0') END FROM payment_logs
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_logs ( payment_id, user_id, benefit_id, card_id, partner_order_id, amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{userId}, #{benefitId}, #{cardId}, #{partnerOrderId}, #{amount}, #{discountAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{finalAmount}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_logs SET status = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tid = #{tid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message = #{errorMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE partner_order_id = #{partnerOrderId}
